# Barangay Konek workspace

- Angular standalone components with SCSS.
- Mobile-first Angular Material UI.
- Preserve `barangay-app.html` as the existing React prototype.
- The new app lives in `barangay-konek-angular/`.
- Prototype persistence uses localStorage until Supabase is introduced.
- Build a responsive app shell and pages for Dashboard, Community, Marketplace, Admin, and Profile.
